messages:
ajay: quick handoff — I'm stepping off in 20m. Ongoing incident, keeping it brief. Primary for next 12h: maria (you). Secondary: sam. Coverage gap note: east-coast 02:00-04:00 local might be light if maria is on PTO tomorrow, flag in calendar.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-2027 triggered: embeddings-queue-backlog in eu-west-1 (severity: P1) — 3 alerts firing.

ajay: Current state: embeddings ingestion backlog spiked after a mis-scheduled batch job at ~1978900800. Queue depth peaked ~2200, now ~480 and slowly draining. We rolled a mitigation earlier: scaled embeddings-worker pool from 4 -> 12 replicas in eu-west-1 and temporarily disabled prefetch for medium customers.

sam: confirming CPU on workers was the limiter earlier. scaled nodes helped, but tail latency still high (~1.6s p95 for embeddings calls) and token-store writes are showing intermittent 500ms+.

ajay: Customer impact: several mid-tier customers seeing failed or slow embedding requests. Affected product: semantic-search and autocomplete for a handful of tenants (ids redacted in public channel). Customer-impact classification: partial-degradation for embeddings (SLO degraded for a small percentage of traffic). No revenue-impacting outages reported yet but support tickets are arriving.

ajay: What we've done so far:
- applied autoscale override to embeddings-worker in eu-west-1 (+8 replicas)
- disabled eager prefetch for medium tier (config flag: embeddings.prefetch.enabled=false)
- routed low-priority traffic to model:embedding-small to reduce pressure on default model
- increased token-store write concurrency from 8 -> 16 for affected region

ajay: Commands used (kept here for next shift):
```
# scale pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment embeddings-worker --replicas=12 --context=eu-west-1

# toggle prefetch via configmap
kubectl -n inference patch configmap embeddings-config -p '{"data":{"prefetch.enabled":"false"}}'

# route low priority requests
curl -X POST "https://routing.redwood.internal/routes" -d '{"route":"low-priority","model":"embedding-small","region":"eu-west-1"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN"
```

maria: got it — I'm primary. I'll keep the pool scaled and watch queue depth. First action: validate autoscaler didn't get stuck and check pod restart loops.

ajay: FYI the autoscaler saw a flurry and paused for ~3m; I manually forced the replica increase. Check HPA: `kubectl -n inference get hpa embeddings-worker -o yaml` — if currentReplicas != desiredReplicas, force sync with the controller.

pager-duty-bot: Pager acknowledged by maria.

maria: Acknowledged. I'll open a short incident thread in #incidents after this, and ping support for impacted customers. Sam — can you take token-store logs and grep for 5xx after 1978900700? prefer we have traces before we escalate to infra.

sam: on it. pulling logs now, will paste snippets.

sam: log snippet (high level):
```
[1978900823] token-store write timeout for tenant t-42 (500ms)
[1978900845] token-store write error 502 for tenant t-17
[1978900901] write succeeded after retry
```

ajay: Runbook refs: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/embeddings-queue (priority checklist), and postmortem template: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/postmortem-template. Key steps in runbook: check HPA, scale workers, disable prefetch, route low-priority traffic, contact infra if token-store latencies persist.

maria: Action plan for my shift:
1) Monitor queue depth and p95/p99 latency dashboards (link: https://dashboards.redwood/embeddings?region=eu-west-1) every 15m.
2) Confirm no pod restart loops.
3) If queue depth not trending down in 20m, trigger additional 8 replicas and throttle ingest at the API gateway for medium tier (rate-limit rule id: rl-ingest-eu-1978).
4) If token-store 5xx persists >10m, open infra escalation and consider failover to token-store-standby in us-west-2.

ajay: Known caveats: the routing fallback to embedding-small increases token usage and raises cost; notify product if we keep it >2h. Also the prefetch toggle is global to medium tier in eu-west-1 — re-enable only after stable drain and a short warmup.

maria: Noted. I'll update this thread with action logs. If I need escalation, I'll ping @ajay and @sam and create a bridge.

ajay: Two more housekeeping items:
- I've added a GA comment to the support tickets summarizing what we did and that we're monitoring.
- Left an adhoc note in PagerDuty incident INC-2027 with links to the runbook.

maria: thanks — I'll take it from here. Quick checklist for whoever relieves me: check the routing override and prefetch flag, confirm queue depth <200 and p95 <500ms before scaling back.

oncall-bot: Reminder: next rotation starts 1978930000 UTC — please ensure runbook updates before sign-off.

ajay: sign-off: leaving handoff in 12m. Ping me for any infra escalations. :thumbsup:
